message.content:
```python
import os
import dd4hep
from dd4hep import kernel, importConstants, Geometry
from DDG4 import Geant4, setupUI, setupTrackingField, EventAction, Gun, setupTracker, PhysicsList, execute

# Initialize the DD4hep kernel
dd4hep_kernel = kernel()
dd4hep_kernel.initialize()

# Load geometry from XML file in DD4hepExamplesINSTALL
geometry_path = os.path.join(os.environ['DD4hepExamplesINSTALL'], 'DDDetectors/compact/Tracker.xml')
geometry = Geometry(geometry_path)
dd4hep_kernel.load(geometry_path)

# Import constants from detector description
importConstants(dd4hep_kernel.detectorDescription())

# Set up Geant4 simulation instance
g4 = Geant4(dd4hep_kernel)

# Set up user interface
setupUI(g4)

# Set up tracking field
setupTrackingField(g4)

# Set up event actions
event_action = EventAction()
g4.event_action = event_action

# Set up particle gun
gun = Gun()
gun.particle = "gamma"
gun.energy = "5*keV"
gun.multiplicity = 1
g4.generator_action = gun

# Set up tracker
setupTracker(g4)

# Set up physics list
physics = PhysicsList()
physics.addPhysics("emstandard_opt3")
physics.addPhysics("decay")
physics.addPhysics("hadronelastic")
physics.addPhysics("hadroninelastic")
physics.addPhysics("ion")
physics.addPhysics("neutron_hp")
g4.physics_list = physics

# Execute the Geant4 simulation
execute(g4)
```
